verdict.rationale: Cal.com explicitly lists 'collective scheduling' as a supported event type alongside round-robin and group scheduling, and the slots API supports checking multiple usernames together to find times when 2+ people are simultaneously available, which is the mechanism collective events rely on. However, unlike round-robin (which has detailed documented configuration for priority/weight/host groups), there is no equivalent detailed doc excerpt confirming the 'only show slots when every required host is free' logic specifically for collective type. Missing for 10: dedicated collective-event-type configuration docs analogous to the round-robin config docs, and independent/hands-on confirmation that collective slot-blocking works as described.
